description: This file defines a 'NotesList' component for a note-taking application's frontend, built with LightningJS. The component manages a list of notes, handles user interactions for navigation and creating new notes, and renders notes within a styled interface.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays a scrollable list of notes, allowing selection and creation of notes.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes the component's state with the application's store.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with empty title and content.

methods.name: _moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the selected note index up or down in the list.
